papers.title_en: VTC-AUDIT: An Interventional Reliability Audit for Visual-Token Compression under Paired Image Shifts
papers.evidence: 审计视觉语言模型中剪枝与剪枝合并式视觉令牌压缩
papers.tldr: 视觉token压缩通常只看干净准确率与效率，掩盖了图像偏移下未压缩模型正确、压缩模型却失败的风险。作者提出VTC-AUDIT，只在成对图像上估计这种增量风险，并交叉“用哪张图选token位置”和“用哪张图提供特征”形成四臂。在三个8-9B视觉语言模型、四个任务、八种偏移上审计两种免训练压缩器，共产生70.8万条推理记录。结果显示在偏移图上重选位置会使失败率显著上升，且该结论可复现。
papers.abstract_en: Visual-token compression is usually evaluated by clean accuracy and efficiency, but these averages do not reveal failures that compression introduces under an image shift where the uncompressed model stays correct. We introduce VTC-AUDIT, which estimates this incremental risk only on pairs where the full model is correct on both images and the compressed model is correct on the clean image. The four arms then cross two binary choices: which image selects the retained token positions, and which image supplies the visual features. We audit three open 8-9B vision-language models on four tasks and eight pre-specified shifts. We evaluate two training-free compressors---hard-pruning DivPrune and prune-and-merge ApET---at a matched 25% retained-position budget, producing 708,000 inference records. Reselecting positions on the shifted image, rather than reusing the clean-image positions, raises the failure rate in all six model-compressor settings. The increase is 3.04-9.60 percentage points for DivPrune and 2.05-4.20 percentage points for ApET, with every 95% interval above zero. Repeating the audit on a separately resampled second manifest reproduces all six increases. In a pooled monitor audit across the four benchmarks, support Jaccard instability fails the practical AUROC criterion of 0.65 in all six settings, whereas clean compressed-model uncertainty clears it. Thus, support turnover is a weak ranking signal under the audited benchmark mixture, while clean compressed-model uncertainty is substantially more informative. These results suggest that future visual-token compression evaluations should report conditional reliability alongside clean accuracy and efficiency.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuqi Li, Chuanyue Yan, Neil Rodrigues, Xianglong Wang, Xiaoqin Feng, Junming Liu, Xi Xiao, Zhongwei Cheng, Wei Li, Lin Chen, Yingli Tian
papers.evidence: 综述视频大模型无训练推理加速涵盖PTQ与视觉token缩减
papers.tldr: 视频大模型处理长视觉序列时计算、延迟和内存开销高，且免训练加速需兼顾任务相关时空证据。本文按推理管线干预阶段梳理输入、视觉编码、投影器、预填充与解码方法，并将PTQ作为跨阶段扩展单独讨论。文章分析干预位置对证据保留与计算节省的影响，指出局部效率提升未必转化为端到端加速。最后结合已有研究与统一评测实验，给出精度—延迟权衡的定量证据与评估视角。
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.
